run.title: Acme Books CLAUDE.md Audit
run.heading: Acme Books
run.subject: CLAUDE.md
run.outcome: Make the always-loaded CLAUDE.md smaller, and fix two rules that point sessions the wrong way.
run.method: Read the whole file (34 lines, loaded in every session). Checked the lint, static analysis, test, git hook and CI config for rules a tool already enforces. Counted how many files follow each rule. Gave borderline lines to 3 small models each, without the line, and asked whether it changed their work. A second model checked every rewrite for a change in meaning.

groups.title: Delete 3 lines the repo already covers
groups.lede: A tool enforces it or a file states it. A session that never reads these lines still does the right thing.

groups.title: Turn the payouts summary into a read-before trigger
groups.lede: A pointer says when to read a doc. A summary loads the doc's words into every session and goes stale when the doc changes.

groups.title: Applied automatically
groups.lede: Standard CLI usage. You applied every change of this kind in the last 24 decisions.

changes.title: Name the Livewire default that causes the mistake
changes.why: The line describes the folder layout, which a session sees in the code. The real trap is `make:livewire`: in Livewire 4 it makes single-file components by default.
changes.skip: A session runs `make:livewire` and gets a single-file component next to class-based pages.

write: - Pages are class-based Livewire components, never single-file components (the `make:livewire` default).

evidence.text: Livewire's config sets `make_command.type` to `sfc`, and the app does not override it.

check.summary: Both lines cover every page component, and the new one adds the default a session would otherwise follow.

changes.title: Drop the job list from the import-queue rule
changes.why: The list names 3 of the 7 import jobs and goes stale as jobs are added. The rule is the queue.
changes.skip: The list of 3 jobs stays, and sessions keep reading it as the complete set.

write: - Import jobs run on the `imports` queue.

evidence.text: 7 classes in `app/Jobs/Imports`, 6 of them on the `imports` queue.

check.summary: `ImportPriceList` runs on the `prices` queue in `config/horizon.php`, so the general rule is false for it.

changes.title: Move the factory rule to tests/CLAUDE.md
changes.why: Only sessions that edit tests need it, and every test lives under `tests/`. A session reads a test before it edits one, so the scoped file loads in time.
changes.skip: Every session keeps loading a rule that only test edits need.

evidence.text: A fresh agent asked to add a test read `tests/Feature/CheckoutTest.php` first, so the scoped file loads.

changes.title: Drop the sentence under "Hard constraints"
changes.why: It repeats the heading and names no rule. The test was close, so it is your call.
changes.skip: Nothing breaks. The file keeps one sentence that changes no session's work.

evidence.text: 3 small models did a task the section governs without the sentence: 2 said cut, 1 said keep.
Lockfiles hold every package the section names.

changes.title: `composer dev`
changes.why: The standard Laravel script, defined in `composer.json`.

changes.title: `strict_types` and `final`
changes.why: Pint adds both on every commit, and an architecture test fails if one is missing.

evidence.text: `pint.json` rules `declare_strict_types` and `final_class`, run by the pre-commit hook.

changes.title: Payouts doc
changes.why: Says when to read it instead of what it holds.

write: - Read `docs/payouts.md` before you change the payout run or the finance CSV.

check.summary: The doc covers the run, the lock, retries and the CSV, and the trigger reaches all four.

questions.text: The pointer to `docs/search.md` names a file that does not exist. What should happen to it?
questions.why: No doc and no branch holds that file. Only you know whether it is coming.

options.label: Delete the pointer
options.detail: Add it back with the doc.

options.label: Keep it
options.detail: The doc is on its way.

kept.why: "Pays publishers monthly" kept all 3 test models away from instant payouts.

kept.title: `composer test` is the full gate
kept.why: Names the gate. 3 of 3 models needed it.
